faqs.q: What is a Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi used for?
faqs.a: A coiled tubing quad BOP carries four ram cavities in one body, typically blind ram on top, then shear ram, slip ram and pipe ram at the bottom. It sits below the CT injector head and above the wellhead riser, and this 5-1/8" 10,000 psi unit is for sour-service CT well intervention.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi?
faqs.a: The Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi is rated 10,000 psi cold working pressure, 10K class, at a 5-1/8" vertical bore. Every unit gets a hydrostatic shell test at 1.5 times rated working pressure, which is a test figure and not an operating limit. The temperature rating is -20°F to 180°F (-29°C to 82°C).

faqs.q: What bore size and end connections does the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi have?
faqs.a: This unit has a 5-1/8" vertical bore with API 6A 5-1/8" 10K connections: studded top (with CT-stripper integration) and flanged bottom. Approximate transport weight is 3,200 kg. Confirm the connection style on your RFQ so it matches the wellhead and the stack above it.

faqs.q: Is the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi suitable for sour (H2S) service?
faqs.a: Yes, the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi is listed as sour service to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156. The forged AISI 4130 alloy steel body has hardness controlled to a maximum of 22 HRC and is Charpy V-notch tested at low temperature. Give H2S partial pressure, temperature and chloride content on the RFQ for final material sign-off.

faqs.q: What OEM equipment is the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi equivalent to?
faqs.a: The Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi is listed as a matched-pressure equivalent to Cameron CT 5-1/8" 10K Quad, NOV CT Quad 5-1/8" 10K, Hydril CT 5-1/8" 10K Quad and Jereh CT Quad 5-1/8" 10K. faqs.q: What API and certification documents come with the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi?

faqs.q: What do I order with the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi for a complete stack?

See [BOP control units](/c/bop-control-units), [ram blocks](/c/bop-ram-blocks) and [choke and kill manifolds](/c/bop-choke-kill).

faqs.q: Where is the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi used?

faqs.q: How does the Coiled Tubing Quad BOP, 5-1/8" 10,000 psi differ from its nearest sibling?

faqs.q: What is an API 16A ram blowout preventer used for?
faqs.a: An API 16A ram blowout preventer is the core of the well-control stack: hydraulic rams close on the pipe, on the open hole or shear through the string to shut the well in on a kick. For deep wells, two ram preventers are usually combined with an annular preventer and, where the well is drilled under pressure, a rotating device.

faqs.q: What sizes and pressures does the Indus API 16A ram BOP cover?
faqs.a: The published range is 7-1/16" to 30" nominal bore and 5,000 to 20,000 psi working pressure, in single or double ram bodies. Each unit is configured to the job, and the general arrangement drawing and data book index come with the quotation.

faqs.q: Which rams should an API 16A ram BOP stack carry?
faqs.a: Usually pipe rams sized to the drill pipe, or variable-bore rams for tapered strings, plus blind or blind-shear rams, with an annular preventer above. The well programme and regulator set the arrangement. See [ram blocks and assemblies](/c/bop-ram-blocks) and [annular BOPs](/c/bop-annular).

faqs.q: What temperature and material classes does the API 16A ram BOP offer?
faqs.a: The listing gives temperature ratings T-75/250 to T-0/350 (-59 °C to 177 °C), API 6A material classes DD, EE, FF and HH, and PSL 1 to 4 with PR1 or PR2. Hydrostatic tests follow API 6A / 16A / 16C at the PSL ordered, so state the class on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Can an API 16A ram BOP be used in sour wells?
faqs.a: Yes, in material classes DD to HH to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156. Send the H2S content, temperature and fluids on the RFQ so the correct material class and PSL are quoted.

faqs.q: Is the Indus ram blowout preventer made to API 16A?
faqs.a: Yes. It is built to API 16A and API 6A, and supplied as an API-certified, API-monogrammed unit from an API-licensed manufacturer, with the API certificate and monogram documentation supplied with the order. Hydrostatic tests follow API 6A / 16A / 16C at the PSL ordered.

faqs.q: What documents come with an API 16A ram blowout preventer?
faqs.a: You receive API 6A documentation for the PSL ordered: material certificates, heat-treatment and NDE records, the hydrostatic test record (and gas test at PSL 3G and 4), and the dimensional report. Third-party inspection and extra tests are added when the order specifies them.

faqs.q: What operates an API 16A ram BOP and what connects to it?
faqs.a: The ram BOP is hydraulic with manual locks, with hydraulic bonnet cylinders and API 6A flanged or studded ends and side outlets for choke and kill lines. See [BOP control units](/c/bop-control-units), [choke and kill manifolds](/c/bop-choke-kill) and [drilling spools](/c/bop-spools-adapters).

faqs.q: What should I send for a ram BOP quotation?
faqs.a: Send the working pressure, bore sizes, end connections, material and temperature class, PSL, the fluids and H2S content, and the layout or P&ID. We review the data sheet before quoting and flag anything that needs clarifying, then list any deviation from an operator specification before the order is placed.

faqs.a: It is used for drilling, workover, completion and well testing. The range of sizes, 7-1/16" to 30", covers small-bore workover stacks and large-bore drilling stacks, and the fixed Cameron-style units in [Ram BOPs](/c/bop-ram) cover the common GCC configurations.
